class.name: SceneryMeshRenderingServer
class.brief_description: The meshes a scenery places as they are, drawn while the camera is near, by RID.
class.description: Meshes a scenery places as they are - a plugin's world's buildings, platforms and bridges, made as [ArrayMesh] resources of its sectors. The server keeps each mesh with its surfaces' materials and draws it with a [RenderingServer] instance only while the camera is within its range ([SceneryStreamingServer]); nothing more is done with it.

method.name: mesh_create
method.description: [param mesh] placed by [param transform] in [param scenario], drawn while the camera is within [param range_end] of its centre; 0 takes the draw distance.

method.name: mesh_free
method.description: [param mesh] freed with its instance and its registration in [SceneryStreamingServer].

method.name: mesh_set_scenario
method.description: The world [param mesh] is drawn in; an empty RID draws it nowhere, as when its node is out of the world.
